backend.code:
from assemblejs import Runtime, ModuleLoader, IslandHydrator
from assemblejs.optimization import TreeShaker, BundleSplitter
import asyncio

class AssembleJSRuntime:
    def __init__(self, config):
        self.runtime = Runtime(config)
        self.loader = ModuleLoader()
        self.hydrator = IslandHydrator()
        
    async def load_module(self, module_name: str, options: dict):
        """Dynamically load and initialize a micro-frontend module"""
        
        # Load module with intelligent caching
        module = await self.loader.load(
            module_name,
            version=options.get('version', 'latest'),
            fallback=options.get('fallback'),
            timeout=options.get('timeout', 5000)
        )
        
        # Optimize bundle
        if options.get('optimize', True):
            module = await self.optimize_module(module)
            
        # Hydrate if it's an island
        if module.type == 'island':
            await self.hydrator.hydrate(
                module,
                strategy=options.get('hydration', 'progressive'),
                priority=options.get('priority', 'normal')
            )
            
        return module
        
    async def optimize_module(self, module):
        """Tree-shake and split bundles for optimal performance"""
        shaker = TreeShaker()
        splitter = BundleSplitter()
        
        # Remove unused code
        module = await shaker.shake(module, {
            'sideEffects': False,
            'usedExports': True
        })
        
        # Split into optimal chunks
        chunks = await splitter.split(module, {
            'strategy': 'granular',
            'maxSize': '50kb',
            'minSize': '10kb'
        })
        
        return chunks

infrastructure.name: K8s.yaml
infrastructure.code:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: assemblejs-shell
  namespace: assemblejs
  labels:
    app: assemblejs
    component: shell
spec:
  replicas: 3
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxSurge: 1
      maxUnavailable: 0
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: assemblejs-shell
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: assemblejs-shell
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: shell
        image: assemblejs/shell:latest
        ports:
        - containerPort: 3000
        env:
        - name: FEDERATION_ENDPOINT
          value: "http://federation-gateway:4000"
        - name: CACHE_STRATEGY
          value: "aggressive"
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /health
            port: 3000
          initialDelaySeconds: 30
        resources:
          requests:
            memory: "256Mi"
            cpu: "250m"
          limits:
            memory: "512Mi"
            cpu: "500m"
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: assemblejs-shell
spec:
  selector:
    app: assemblejs-shell
  ports:
  - port: 80
    targetPort: 3000
  type: LoadBalancer
---
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
  name: assemblejs-ingress
  annotations:
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/enable-cors: "true"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/cors-allow-methods: "GET, POST, OPTIONS"
    nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/cors-allow-headers: "X-Module-Version,X-Island-Priority"
spec:
  rules:
  - host: app.assemblejs.com
    http:
      paths:
      - path: /
        pathType: Prefix
        backend:
          service:
            name: assemblejs-shell
            port:
              number: 80

devops.name: CI-CD.yml
devops.code:
name: AssembleJS Module Federation CI/CD

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  test-modules:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    strategy:
      matrix:
        module: [shell, header, cart, footer, checkout]
        framework: [react, vue, angular]
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Setup Node.js
      uses: actions/setup-node@v3
      with:
        node-version: '20'
        cache: 'npm'
    
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: npm ci --workspace=@assemblejs/${{ matrix.module }}
    
    - name: Run framework compatibility tests
      run: |
        npm run test:integration \
          --workspace=@assemblejs/${{ matrix.module }} \
          -- --framework=${{ matrix.framework }}
    
    - name: Test module federation
      run: |
        npm run test:federation \
          --workspace=@assemblejs/${{ matrix.module }}
    
    - name: Performance benchmarks
      run: |
        npm run benchmark \
          --workspace=@assemblejs/${{ matrix.module }} \
          -- --threshold=95

  build-and-deploy:
    needs: test-modules
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v3
    
    - name: Build modules
      run: |
        npm run build:all -- --mode=production
        npm run optimize:islands
    
    - name: Generate module manifest
      run: |
        node scripts/generate-manifest.js > dist/modules.json
    
    - name: Deploy to CDN
      env:
        AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID }}
        AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY }}
      run: |
        aws s3 sync dist/ s3://assemblejs-modules/ \
          --cache-control "public,max-age=31536000,immutable" \
          --metadata-directive REPLACE
    
    - name: Invalidate CloudFront
      run: |
        aws cloudfront create-invalidation \
          --distribution-id ${{ secrets.CLOUDFRONT_DIST_ID }} \
          --paths "/modules.json"
    
    - name: Deploy edge workers
      run: |
        wrangler publish \
          --env production \
          --var MODULE_ORIGIN:${{ secrets.MODULE_ORIGIN }}
    
    - name: Update Kubernetes
      run: |
        kubectl set image deployment/assemblejs-shell \
          shell=assemblejs/shell:${{ github.sha }} \
          --namespace=assemblejs
    
    - name: Run smoke tests
      run: |
        npm run test:e2e -- --env=production --smoke

activity.author: Zachariah Ayers
activity.comment: AssembleJS is now public! Built this from scratch to solve the micro-frontend problems I kept running into at enterprise scale. SSR support was the hardest part to get right.

businessRequirements.businessContext: Modern web applications require multiple teams to work independently while maintaining a cohesive user experience. Traditional monolithic frontends create bottlenecks, forcing teams to coordinate deployments and share the same technology stack.
businessRequirements.problemStatement: The monolithic frontend architecture is blocking team productivity. Teams cannot deploy independently, are forced to use the same framework, and face merge conflicts that delay releases. This is costing the organization development velocity and limiting our ability to adopt new technologies.
businessValue: 85% faster development cycles through independent deployments
Enable 10+ teams to work autonomously without conflicts
Support React, Vue, and Angular in the same application
Enable gradual migration from legacy systems
acceptanceCriteria: Support multiple JavaScript frameworks (React, Vue, Angular) in a single application
Sub-second module loading with intelligent preloading
Automatic fallbacks when remote modules fail
Performance metrics showing <100ms overhead vs monolithic app
Accessibility score of 95+ on all modules

risks.mitigation: Comprehensive CLI tools and developer documentation
Edge caching and intelligent preloading strategies
